guest_rpc.device: CUDA0 after exact guest UUID verification

ssh.host_key_rule: Obtain and verify host key through independent candidate provisioning evidence. Never trust ssh-keyscan alone or StrictHostKeyChecking=no.

candidate_inference.note: Inert option map only. No warmup does not suppress initialization. Actual work on both GPUs must be demonstrated, not inferred from residency.

host_service_change: Keep production AF_UNIX-only service unchanged; a future reviewed candidate profile narrowly permits its loopback TCP connection.
security_note: RPC has no trustworthy public-network security boundary. Loopback is reachable by local users; retain single-user custody, restricted guest account and no untrusted tenants. SSH protects transit, not malicious local clients.
rollback: Close only session-owned tunnel, worker and socket; preserve keys and logs; no global kill or service replacement.
